Maya (CSM): Hey team — post-launch smoke check for ZephyrPoint private deployment. Customer reported missing audit events and one service failing to call embeddings. Can we triage quickly? :wave:

Ravi (EngOps): On it. I see the VPC route table for app-subnet lacks a route to the NAT gateway (so outbound to embeddings provider would fail). Running a quick check: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0zeph*`

Diego (SRE): I pushed the route (rtb-0a1b2c3 -> 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-09f8). App calls are succeeding now from our test pod. Also noticed KMS policy denies cross-account role usage — that might block customer audit-forwarding to their SIEM.

Nora (Support): Monitoring flagged audit exporter failures at 2026-03-20T14:32 UTC with 403 from their Splunk endpoint. After Ravi's route fix I saw retries succeed for a handful of batches. Still seeing intermittent 403s for older log batches.

Ravi (EngOps): Confirmed egress is working; embeddings request returned 200 from staging. One more ask: firewall rule to outbound IPs for embedding vendor needs adding to the egress allowlist on their perimeter firewall — requesting ZephyrPoint network team to apply.

Diego (SRE): For KMS, plan is to amend key policy to include the customer's cross-account role. Command I'll run: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --policy file://zephyr-kms-policy.json` — policy will add `arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/zephyr-app-role` with Encrypt/Decrypt. I'll paste the policy snippet in the ticket once done.

deploy-bot: rollout/zephyrpoint-private v1.2.3 -> completed at 2026-03-20T14:38:45Z :white_check_mark:

Nora (Support): I'll re-run the exporter for the failed batches and watch retention. If KMS update is delayed, we might need a short window where logs are buffered locally — will coordinate with Diego.

Maya (CSM): Great progress — quick summary/action items: 1) Diego to finalize KMS policy and post to the ticket, 2) Ravi to follow up with ZephyrPoint on perimeter egress allowlist, 3) Nora to confirm replay of failed audit batches and retention, 4) I'll update ZephyrPoint with ETA and set 16:00 PT checkpoint. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
